page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It is configured with 8 vCPUs, representing 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, and 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes a bundled 959 GB local SSD storage volume and operates on the KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the CPU and memory subsystems generally operate in the lower tiers. Stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests, along with Geekbench single-core and multi-core metrics, place the instance in the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Single-threaded compression and decompression tasks via gzip and bzip3 register in the bottom 10%. However, the instance demonstrates average performance in Passmark CPU scores and Redis SET operations, the latter reaching 6.1 million operations per second. Small-model LLM inference using a 135M parameter model also achieves average tier speeds, though scaling to a 7B parameter model drops performance to the bottom 10%.

The primary tradeoff of this instance lies in its storage-to-compute profile. While CPU-heavy workloads and memory-bandwidth-intensive operations are constrained by older architecture and lower benchmark scores, the inclusion of a 959 GB local SSD provides significant local storage capacity. This makes the instance qualitatively cost-efficient for storage-centric workloads that do not require high-performance compute. Appropriate workloads include local database hosting, caching layers like Redis, and general-purpose applications requiring moderate compute paired with high local storage capacity.
